scene: The steaming copper kettle reveals a secret brass valve and map.
picture: First-person close-up of an ornate copper kettle hissing with steam over embers. A notched brass valve is fitted to the spout on the left. A folded parchment map rests beneath the coiled wire handle at centre. Through curling steam on the right, the pavilion steps are visible. Two gloved hands hover ready.
shown: a notched brass turn-valve fitted to the kettle spout on the left
a water-stained parchment map tucked beneath the kettle handle at centre
the wooden entrance steps leading rightward toward the garden pavilion

variants.scene: Steam curls from the giant kettle above glowing coals on the stone path.
Warm embers crackle under the kettle, where an intriguing paper map hangs.
